title: KoreLumina — Master OS - KoreLumina Commit Guardrail — message 2

metadata.content:
The task is:
Fix KoreLumina preview/runtime behavior.
Current focus:


Preview frame layout bug

Right/bottom strip appears even when no iframe is rendered, so it’s likely in PreviewFrame wrapper layout.


Runtime stop/start bug

After stopping, the UI shows running/stale state or starts again incorrectly. Need to confirm whether backend auto-restart or frontend useRuntimeBoot() is responsible.


Preview not rebinding after stop/start

Runtime can be running on 4201, but PreviewFrame falls back to skeleton because runtimeUrl is cleared/not restored.


We should continue from the last concrete lead: inspect useRuntimeBoot.ts and runtime stop/start flow, not image generation.
